name: nanoCH32V003 (MuseLab)
description: Tiny breadboard board for the 10-cent CH32V003F4U6 (48 MHz RISC-V, 16 KB flash) with USB-C power, 24 MHz crystal, reset button and LED; the cheapest way to try the CH32V003.
notes: The USB-C port is power only (CH32V003 has no USB): programming needs a WCH-LinkE (about $5) on the 3-pin SWIO header. Budget for that.

Two rows of 11 pins at 2.54 mm (top: G, C4-C0, D0, 3V3, A2, A1, D1; bottom: G, 5V, C5-C7, D2-D7) plus a 3-pin GND/SWIO/3V3 programming header; QFN-20 chip. The same PCB takes CH32V002F4U6 / CH32V004F6U1.
Size, price and I/O voltage are estimates from product photos; no official dimension drawing found.
